metadata.captureTimestamp.interval: ARFrame timestamp intervals as delivered by ARSession (capture timestamp cadence, not display presentation)
metadata.capture_semantics: ARSession delivery callback interval, not sensor exposure cadence
metadata.cpu_execution_time: processCPUSeconds is cumulative process user+system CPU from getrusage, not per-subsystem or wall time
metadata.duration_semantics: monotonic elapsed wall time; not CPU/GPU execution time
metadata.first_presented_hero: unmeasured; correlate selected-asset render proxy with separate screen recording
metadata.gpu_execution_time: Postprocess command buffer GPU samples GPU start/end on completed command buffers; entire buffer, not just pass or presentation; absent when detached/unavailable
metadata.instrumentation: enabled only with -ARBaselineMetrics; bounded signposts and buffers
metadata.quantiles: nearest-rank recent/startup; whole-epoch histogram upper bounds at 1ms resolution, >1000ms overflow explicit
metadata.render_semantics: RealityKit scene-update interval proxy, not display presentation
metadata.sceneUpdateProxy.interval: RealityKit scene-update callback intervals; presentation unmeasured
metadata.target_thermal: no serious state at 10 minutes; observe to 15 minutes
